procrastinate.definition:
v. postpone doing what one should be doing
v. postpone or delay needlessly

procrastinated.translation: v. 拖延, 耽搁( procrastinate的过去式和过去分词 )

procrastinates.definition:
v postpone doing what one should be doing
v postpone or delay needlessly
procrastinates.translation: v. 拖延, 耽搁( procrastinate的第三人称单数 )

procrastinating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Procrastinate
procrastinating.translation: v. 拖延, 耽搁( procrastinate的现在分词 ); 拖拉

procrastination.definition: n. the act of procrastinating; putting off or delaying or defering an action to a later time
procrastination.translation:
n. 拖延, 因循, 耽搁
[法] 拖延, 耽搁, 因循

procrastinations.definition:
plural of procrastination
n. the act of procrastinating; putting off or delaying or defering an action to a later time
procrastinations.translation:
(procrastination 的复数) n. 拖延, 因循, 耽搁
[法] 拖延, 耽搁, 因循

procrastinator.definition: n. someone who postpones work (especially out of laziness or habitual carelessness)
procrastinator.translation: n. 拖延者, 因循者

procrastinators.definition:
plural of procrastinator
n. someone who postpones work (especially out of laziness or habitual carelessness)
procrastinators.translation: (procrastinator 的复数) n. 拖延者, 因循者

procrastinatory.definition: a. Of or pertaining to procrastination; dilatory.

procrasturbating.definition:
Using masturbation to otherwise occupy yourself while pressing matters await.
> I had a paper due today, but I spent all night procrasturbating, so fuck that noise.

procreant.definition:
a. Generating; producing; productive; fruitful; assisting
   in procreation.
n. One who, or that which, procreates.
procreant.translation: a. 有生殖力的, 多产的, 生殖的

procreate.definition: v have offspring or produce more individuals of a given animal or plant
procreate.translation:
vt. 生, 生殖, 产生
vi. 生殖

procreated.translation: v. 生（儿、女）, 生育, 生殖( procreate的过去式和过去分词 )

procreates.definition: v have offspring or produce more individuals of a given animal or plant
procreates.translation: v. 生（儿、女）, 生育, 生殖( procreate的第三人称单数 )

procreating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Procreate
procreating.translation: v. 生（儿、女）, 生育, 生殖( procreate的现在分词 )

procreation.definition: n the sexual activity of conceiving and bearing offspring
procreation.translation:
n. 生产, 生殖
[医] 生殖, 生育

procreative.definition: s producing new life or offspring
procreative.translation:
a. 会生产的, 有生殖力的
[医] 生殖的, 能生殖的

procreator.definition: n. One who begets; a father or sire; a generator.

procrustean.definition: a. of or relating to the mythical giant Procrustes or the mode of torture practiced by him
procrustean.translation: a. 普罗克汝斯忒斯的, 强求一致的

procrustean bed.translation: 普罗克汝斯忒斯之床, 强求一致的政策

procrustes.definition: n. (Greek mythology) a mythical giant who was a thief and murderer; he would capture people and tie them to an iron bed, stretching them or hacking off their legs to make them fit; was killed by Theseus
procrustes.translation: n. 普罗克汝斯忒斯(希腊神话人物)
